chapter_seo_title: Dao Gui Yi Xian Chapter 27: Li Huowang Encounters a Two-Faced Spirit
chapter_meta_description: A title-asking spirit with two faces attacks the Lü family camp. Li Huowang tests Danyangzi’s bell and learns the true distance between ordinary people and the supernatural.
og_title: Folk Horror Meets Daoist Cultivation: The Title-Asking Spirit
og_description: Li Huowang faces a boneless, two-faced woman in the forest and discovers the terrifying rules of "asking for a title."
